speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the timing of your symptoms; are you currently in your first, second, or third trimester of pregnancy? Additionally, have you experienced a stiff neck, sensitivity to light, or a rash since becoming ill?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail; the ice cream consumption is an important clue. Did you or anyone you live with have contact with cats, especially if they are litter boxes that were cleaned recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Toxoplasmosis. Given the maternal history of ice cream consumption (suggesting unpasteurized dairy) and your pregnancy, this is a high suspicion for Toxoplasma gondii infection acquired from cat litter or undercooked meat. I will order a Toxoplasma IgM and IgG serology panel immediately.
